title: Repair spell, creature, hazard, and magic-item source projections and selected capabilities
description:
Own known source-fidelity/projection defects in spells, creatures, hazards, and magic
items. Use independently source-enumerated structural families for exhaustive parser
checks where justified. Preserve source material for discovery and DM adjudication.
Add clause-level structure only where faithful source representation or positive
deterministic capabilities require it.
acceptance_criteria:
- Known domain findings are repaired or explicitly dispositioned without erasing source/discovery/state defects.
- Structural parser completeness claims identify an independent source-derived denominator.
- Selected deterministic capabilities are proven against exact source semantics and declare exclusions/residual DM interpretation.
- A capability over part of a record never implies whole-record implementation.
- Model-adjudicated source material remains discoverable and is not engine-pending by default.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
ADR-0020 authority reconciliation applied 2026-09-10 by eshyra-o9bd.19.6.5.
The operative title/description/acceptance criteria supersede contradictory
